validity.recommendation: CHANGE 1 CELL: PipelineType distribution -> transmission (P3368, row 1757).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/DUPLICATE: no concern -- this is a real, well-documented, well-corroborated asset (3+ independent sources: ap22.ru regional daily, neftegaz.ru trade press, tgs.tomsk.ru contractor page, politsib.ru regional outlet), matching GEM's recorded Length/Construction/Owner closely. CLASSIFICATION CONCERN: recorded PipelineType='distribution' is contradicted by every independent source found. The classification test given for this batch is: a газопровод-отвод (branch/lateral pipeline) terminating AT a ГРС (gas distribution station) is TRANSMISSION; межпоселковый (inter-settlement) pipe downstream of the ГРС is DISTRIBUTION. This exact 77km asset is named 'газопровод-отвод' by its own contractor (tgs.tomsk.ru: 'Газопровод-отвод и газораспределительная станция с.Ребриха Алтайского края') and by neftegaz.ru ('газопровод-отвод Шахов - Ребриха от магистрального газопровода (МГП) Новосибирск-Барнаул'), i.e. it is the FEEDER from the P2283 trunk TO the Rebrikha ГРС, not the downstream local distribution mains -- those are described as a SEPARATE, later-stage asset in ap22.ru ('распределительные сети', the local networks the completed 77km отвод + ГРС now make possible for the school/apartments/houses). ap22.ru itself calls the 77km asset a 'магистральный газопровод' (trunk pipeline). Recommend PipelineType -> transmission for P3368. SPEC: SegmentCost has a resolved (not conflicting) discrepancy noted in the paired fills[] record -- an interim 2020 financing figure (>1.1bn RUB, mid-construction) vs. the final 2021 at-completion figure (2bn RUB, matches sheet) -- final figure used, no action needed. CROSS-ROW: see cross_row_leads for P3367 (existence question -- no source found this pass names a distinct 'Barnaul-Shakhi' segment separate from this one) and for P3369/P3370 (Rebrikha's role as the launch point for the planned-but-delayed Rubtsovsk/Slavgorod extensions, corroborated by 2024-2025 dated sources).
